purpose: Second expanded hireable roster: preserved alongside the original interrupted Wave 003 roster; 12 Epic, 6 Legendary, 5 Mythic, 3 Exotic, 2 God. Final three entries are premium-designated.

identity.fantasy: Hunts wounded targets by reading heat, scent, and battlefield residue, then closes with a hooked carbine and execution dash.
identity.silhouette: Charcoal ranger armor, ember-lined hood, asymmetric wolf-mask visor, and a folding hooked rifle carried low like a hunting spear.
identity.lore_hook: Former border warden of the Cinder March who hires only after the player finishes a flawless predator contract.

signature: Bloodtrail Sense reveals recently injured hostiles through nearby cover for a short tactical window.
Houndstep converts a successful mark into one curved high-speed flank dash.
Execution Hook deals bonus stagger only to targets below a visible health threshold.
counterplay: Marks are short-range and decay; Houndstep exposes a predictable landing lane that enemies can punish.

vfx: Thin ember footprints, thermal scent ribbons, and a sharp ash-ring burst around execution-qualified targets.
animation: Low stalking posture shifts into a forward shoulder sprint; successful executions end in a rifle-hook recoil spin rather than a static firing pose.
audio: Dry chain clicks, distant hound-like resonance on marks, and a low heartbeat cue when a target enters execution range.

method: Complete the Vale Predator contract chain.

identity.fantasy: Turns forward movement into defensive momentum, advancing behind a compact hex-shield while breaking fortified lanes.
identity.silhouette: Broad black-and-brass coat armor, tower-shoulder plates, six glowing shield facets orbiting one forearm.
identity.lore_hook: An exiled siege captain whose oath prevents him from retreating while an ally remains downed nearby.

signature: Hexwall Advance projects a narrow moving frontal barrier instead of a stationary bubble.
Bastion Ram stores blocked damage and releases it as a short knockback breach.
Last Rampart accelerates his revive movement when a squadmate is downed behind his wall.
counterplay: Flanking bypasses Hexwall; stored Ram energy is lost if the shield is forced to collapse.

vfx: Six amber barrier facets tessellate into a moving wall, crack visibly under pressure, then implode into geometric sparks when broken.
animation: Heavy planted steps while guarding, shoulder-first acceleration during Ram, and a one-knee shield brace while covering revives.
audio: Layered brass impacts, rising harmonic strain on the wall, and a deep gate-slam sound when Ram releases.

method: Win Rook's moving-fortress challenge.

identity.fantasy: Builds charge from exposed weather and converts it into ricochet precision shots and short squad movement bursts.
identity.silhouette: Translucent blue coat plates, stormglass rifle barrel, silver braids floating slightly in charged air.
identity.lore_hook: Nyra maps impossible thunderstorms and sells her aim only to players who recover a shattered weather lens.

signature: Stormglass Bank gains charge while under open sky or inside active weather events.
Refraction Shot bends once toward a marked secondary target after striking terrain or armor.
Blue Gale grants nearby allies a brief movement burst when Nyra spends a full charge bank.
counterplay: Indoor engagements starve charge; ricochet trajectory is telegraphed by a visible blue line.

vfx: Electric rain beads orbit the rifle, refractive blue arcs bend at ricochet points, and a thin wind halo expands during Blue Gale.
animation: Rifle aim pulls her entire posture into a glass-still stance; full-charge release snaps her coat and braids backward in a pressure wave.
audio: Rain-on-glass ticks while charging, crystalline thunder on ricochet, and a bright wind chime when allies receive Gale.

method: Restore the Tempest Observatory lens array.

identity.fantasy: Challenges one elite at a time, suppressing that target's mobility while gaining parry windows against telegraphed attacks.
identity.silhouette: Lean matte-black armor with a single white edge-line, split mantle, and a long blade that absorbs nearby light.
identity.lore_hook: Kael is the surviving adjudicator of an order that settled wars through ritual single combat.

signature: Black Accord designates one elite as Kael's duel target and reduces his interest in lesser enemies.
Night Parry opens only against clearly telegraphed attacks and converts success into stagger.
Severing Step briefly reduces the duel target's dash or leap effectiveness after a clean blade hit.
counterplay: Multiple enemies can overwhelm him; failed parries impose a recovery lockout.

vfx: Light drains subtly toward the blade, duel targets gain a razor-thin white ring, and parries burst into inverted black-white shards.
animation: Economical fencing footwork, blade held behind the body before counters, and a sharp half-turn recovery after failed parries.
audio: Muted ambience inside a duel, single metallic heartbeats before parry windows, and a vacuum snap on stagger.

method: Defeat Kael in a nonlethal adjudication duel.

identity.fantasy: Creates moving pockets of sensor confusion while tagging dangerous enemies for the squad.
identity.silhouette: Midnight longcoat with animated latitude lines, mirrored half-mask, compact suppressed sidearm and wrist cartography rig.
identity.lore_hook: Sable steals maps from hostile realities and marks paths that officially do not exist.

signature: Dead Meridian suppresses selected enemy detection assists inside a small moving field without granting true invisibility.
Black Pin tags one high-threat enemy and shares the mark with the squad.
Impossible Route reveals authored flank doors, vents, or traversal shortcuts in supported encounters.
counterplay: Direct sight still works; denial radius is small and Black Pin can be cleansed by specific elites.

vfx: Map-lines crawl over nearby surfaces, tagged enemies carry a rotating black compass rose, and hidden-route seams glow briefly like erased ink.
animation: Constant scanning hand gestures, low-profile shoulder rolls through cover, and a map-snap animation when a hidden route is revealed.
audio: Soft sonar inversion, pen-scratch spatial cues, and a subdued compass click when a threat is pinned.

method: Recover three stolen meridian charts.

identity.fantasy: Uses concussive fire and battle shouts to keep mobs off allies while granting resistance to panic-style encounter effects.
identity.silhouette: Massive sea-black plate, barnacle-textured pauldrons, red signal lantern on the chest, rotary cannon slung from a chain harness.
identity.lore_hook: Orin survived the Dreadwake Leviathan and now laughs whenever something larger than a building tries to scare him.

signature: Wakefire sweeps a controlled suppression cone that discourages lesser mobs from advancing.
Anchor Roar grants nearby allies temporary resistance to authored fear or intimidation states.
Chainbrace plants Orin in place to resist knockback while protecting a narrow rear safe lane.
counterplay: Planting removes mobility; suppression loses value against disciplined elites and bosses.

vfx: Salt-black muzzle smoke, red lantern shock rings, and anchor-chain glyphs briefly lock to the ground during Chainbrace.
animation: Weighty cannon harness recoil, chest-forward roar pose, and a two-handed ground brace that visibly transfers force into the terrain.
audio: Ship-hull groans, thunderous breath, rotary cannon rumble, and a low foghorn pulse on Anchor Roar.

method: Clear the Dreadwake wreck without triggering a panic wipe.

identity.fantasy: Uses living thorn devices to pin predators, accelerate taming windows, and convert captured biomass into temporary field medicine.
identity.silhouette: Emerald-black bioarmor, thorn-vine gauntlets, luminous seed capsules, and a coiled living cable across her back.
identity.lore_hook: Vexa was raised by a predatory forest intelligence and treats monsters as negotiations waiting to happen.

signature: Coil Snare grows a temporary thorn lattice that restrains supported non-boss creatures.
Wild Accord widens the player's taming opportunity on species compatible with Vexa's ecology.
Green Debt converts a successful tame or nonlethal capture into one limited healing seed.
counterplay: Fire and cutting effects clear snares quickly; bosses cannot be hard-restrained.

vfx: Fast-growing luminous vines, spore motes that change color with creature disposition, and a green pulse that travels from a tamed creature to the player.
animation: Throws seed capsules underhand, whips vines with full-body momentum, and kneels calmly during taming while combat continues around her.
audio: Wet vine snaps, insectile harmonic clicks, and a warm wooden resonance when a taming state improves.

method: Complete the Verdant Teeth taming pilgrimage.

identity.fantasy: Carries sanctified iron that converts incoming corruption effects into temporary armor for nearby allies.
identity.silhouette: Cathedral-forged iron coat, circular reliquary shield, blunt warhammer with red-hot scripture engraved along the head.
identity.lore_hook: Thane was canonized by soldiers rather than priests after holding a plague gate alone for three nights.

signature: Iron Absolution converts a portion of supported corruption buildup into temporary overshield.
Saintline creates a narrow safe corridor behind Thane while he advances.
Bellhammer Strike creates heavy stagger against necrotic constructs and shielded mobs.
counterplay: Non-corruption damage bypasses his specialty; safe corridor disappears if he sprints or is launched.

vfx: Molten scripture crawls across his shield, corruption particles burn into silver sparks, and hammer impacts emit concentric cathedral-window patterns.
animation: Slow shield advance, shoulder rotation before hammer impact, and a deliberate shield-to-ground kneel while converting corruption.
audio: Deep iron bell tones, scripture hiss, and choir-like distortion that resolves into a clean chord when corruption is cleansed.

method: Defend the Plague Gate memorial event.

identity.fantasy: Places paired short-range rifts for squad repositioning and emergency extraction while harassing enemies from changing angles.
identity.silhouette: Purple-white expedition suit, split cape appearing slightly displaced in space, twin ring devices mounted at the hips.
identity.lore_hook: Mira fell through seventeen failed realities and remembers a different version of every place she visits.

signature: Twin Aperture creates a short-lived authored portal pair between valid nearby surfaces.
Recall Line can pull one downed or critical ally through the nearer aperture under strict range rules.
Crossfire Step rewards Mira with a brief accuracy bonus after she personally traverses her rift.
counterplay: Portals are visible, destroyable, range-limited, and cannot bypass protected encounter boundaries.

vfx: Clean elliptical tears with layered parallax interiors, trailing white-violet displacement streaks, and a compression flash when Recall Line triggers.
animation: She dives shoulder-first through apertures, lands in a low three-point stance, and spins one ring device to collapse a portal manually.
audio: Glass tension rising into a soft spatial boom, doppler-shifted footsteps through rifts, and a high alarm tone before forced collapse.

method: Recover Mira's seventeen expedition anchors.

identity.fantasy: Trades his own temporary overshield for empowered precision bursts, then earns it back through aggressive finishing play.
identity.silhouette: Crimson duelist coat over star-metal plates, luminous red cylinder pistol, constellation scars across one exposed forearm.
identity.lore_hook: Cassian claims a dead star taught him how to gamble with blood; no astronomer has disproved him.

signature: Red Ante spends a fixed overshield chunk to prime an empowered three-shot burst.
Deadstar Return restores part of the wager if Cassian helps finish the primed target.
House Edge briefly improves reload speed after a successful wager cycle.
counterplay: Poor target selection leaves Cassian exposed; overshield spend cannot reduce him below a safety floor.

vfx: Red stellar motes drain from his armor into the pistol, targets gain a tiny eclipsed-star mark, and successful recovery showers sparks back into his chestplate.
animation: Flourished cylinder spin before a wager, rigid two-handed burst stance, then a fast coat-sweep reload on successful recovery.
audio: Casino-chip ticks mixed with stellar crackle, a sharp three-note burst cadence, and a satisfying reversed impact when shield returns.

method: Win the Bloodstar three-contract wager chain.

identity.fantasy: Becomes stronger in darkness and can temporarily dim a localized combat pocket to expose spectral weak points.
identity.silhouette: Pale lunar armor cut by one diagonal black scar motif, crescent glaive, trailing veil made from starless fabric.
identity.lore_hook: Ilyra survived being marked by a moon that no longer exists and hunts things visible only in its absence.

signature: Moonless Pocket dims a bounded area without globally altering the map's lighting.
Scar Sight reveals authored spectral weak points on supported monsters inside the pocket.
Crescent Sweep knocks lesser shadow creatures outward while preserving boss positioning.
counterplay: Bright-zone enemies can force her out of ideal conditions; spectral weak points are temporary and encounter-authored.

vfx: Localized desaturation, silver edge-lighting on hidden weak points, and black crescent trails that remain for a fraction of a second after glaive swings.
animation: Fluid circular glaive forms, veil lagging unnaturally behind movement, and a head-tilt tracking pose when Scar Sight locks on.
audio: Soft lunar hum, cloth moving without wind, and a brittle silver crack when a spectral weak point is struck.

method: Complete a Moonscar hunt during the Nocturne event.

identity.fantasy: Dominates waterline fights, creates temporary current lanes, and can drag incapacitated allies away from exposed shorelines.
identity.silhouette: Black-blue scaled assault suit, manta-shaped shoulder fins, pressure canisters, harpoon rifle with braided cable.
identity.lore_hook: Droven belongs to a drowned city whose soldiers still consider the ocean a road rather than a boundary.

signature: Black Current creates a short directional water-speed lane in supported zones.
Undertow Hook drags a lesser enemy or repositions a downed ally depending on target context.
Pressure Break fires a close-range concussive burst after leaving water.
counterplay: Dry inland zones reduce his specialty; Undertow cannot move protected bosses or objectives.

vfx: Dark current ribbons, compressed bubble shock fronts, and blue-black water sheeting off armor even during short land transitions.
animation: Dive-roll entries, low hydrodynamic sprinting, cable-braced harpoon recoil, and a violent shoulder twist during ally extraction.
audio: Muffled underwater booms, cable whine, and a pressure-pop sound when Black Current activates.

method: Recover the Blacktide standard from the drowned transit tunnels.

identity.fantasy: Plants a moving war standard that coordinates squad focus fire and changes formation based on boss phase.
identity.silhouette: Towering obsidian-gold commander armor, shredded solar banner that emits darkness rather than light, ceremonial rifle-spear.
identity.lore_hook: Seraph Korr led an army beneath a dead sun and still commands as if ten thousand soldiers stand behind him.

signature: Sunless Standard marks a tactical rally zone whose buff changes between assault, brace, and recovery states.
Black Volley coordinates timed NPC ally fire against a designated boss weak point.
Command Debt stores a fraction of squad damage dealt inside the banner and converts it into one stagger pulse.
Last Formation automatically shifts the banner to defense when multiple allies become critical.
counterplay: The standard is destructible and forces grouping; boss movement can pull the fight outside its influence.

vfx: An inverted solar eclipse floats behind the banner, gold command lines connect allies briefly, stored damage appears as black light filling banner runes, and stagger release forms a silent expanding disk.
animation: Banner planting uses a full kneeling spear-thrust, command gestures are broad and readable, rifle-spear attacks transition between ceremonial precision and brutal close defense.
audio: Muted battlefield ambience near the standard, distant army footfalls, low brass commands, and a huge breath-like silence immediately before the stagger pulse.

method: Complete the Dead Sun command raid and earn Korr's oath.

identity.fantasy: Uses bounded aerial bursts to intercept threats, execute marked dives, and catch falling allies before impact.
identity.silhouette: Black chrome wing-rig with six blade-feathers, violet flight mask, narrow energy lance, long split-tail coat.
identity.lore_hook: Valkyra was built for a war above the cloud layer and refuses to accept gravity as a permanent instruction.

signature: Nightwing Burst grants short authored aerial dashes rather than unrestricted flight.
Meteor Intercept dives onto a marked elite and converts vertical distance into stagger up to a safety cap.
Sixth Feather can redirect one lethal fall for a nearby ally into a survivable glide.
Nocturne Mark increases Valkyra's aggression toward airborne threats and exposed weak points.
counterplay: Wing bursts have visible recharge; anti-air enemies and ceilings constrain her strongest angles.

vfx: Six violet contrails split from the wing rig, feather-blades shed brief black sparks, intercept targets gain a descending triangular reticle, and rescued allies receive a temporary glide ribbon.
animation: Explosive wing deployment, spear-forward dive pose, midair roll around incoming fire, and a dramatic one-arm catch animation during fall rescue.
audio: Jet-like harmonic howl, feather blade chimes, accelerating dive tone, and a deep air-catch thump when a rescue succeeds.

method: Defeat Valkyra's aerial trial drones without touching the arena floor.

identity.fantasy: Builds temporary bone sentries from defeated lesser mobs and commands them as disposable positional tools rather than a permanent army.
identity.silhouette: Regal bone lamellar armor, antlered crown grown from fused vertebrae, staff-rifle wrapped in red marrow light.
identity.lore_hook: Orryx betrayed the Grave Architects after deciding death was too valuable to leave under one faction's control.

signature: Crown Levy converts eligible defeated lesser mobs into limited-duration bone sentry charges.
Marrow Order places sentries into guard, focus, or sacrifice positions.
King's Ossuary detonates expiring sentries into a defensive bone wall instead of wasting them.
Usurper Sigil weakens nearby uncontrolled undead coordination without hard-stunning them.
counterplay: No corpses means no sentries; sentries are fragile and bosses cannot be converted.

vfx: Bone fragments assemble from red geometric threads, the crown grows extra prongs with stored charges, sentry orders draw skeletal arrows across the ground, and sacrifice walls erupt in pale ribs.
animation: Staff commands resemble conducting motions, crown tilts toward available remains, and sentry creation uses a two-hand pull as bones rise from the floor.
audio: Marrow rattles, whispered command syllables, dry crown creaks, and a heavy rib-cage slam when Ossuary forms.

method: Break Orryx's binding contract in the Sepulcher Court.

identity.fantasy: Projects combat echoes that imitate movement and muzzle flashes, causing authored enemies to split attention while Vesper attacks from changing lanes.
identity.silhouette: Deep indigo formal armor, mirror-smooth faceplate, four translucent afterimage ribbons pinned to the spine.
identity.lore_hook: Vesper claims to be the echo and insists the original died years ago.

signature: Vesper Echoes replay short authored movement snippets and false muzzle flashes without dealing full damage.
Mirror Claim redirects selected lesser-enemy attention toward an echo for a brief window.
Vesper Swap exchanges position with a surviving echo inside bounded range.
Afterimage Verdict empowers one close burst immediately after a successful swap.
counterplay: Players and elite enemies can distinguish echoes by subtle distortion; area damage clears them efficiently.

vfx: Indigo mirror shards, delayed translucent silhouettes, reversed muzzle flashes, and a polished black ripple at swap origin and destination.
animation: Every dodge leaves a one-beat delayed body double, swaps are punctuated by a backward step into the mirror ripple, and close bursts use elegant one-handed weapon poses.
audio: Doubled footsteps with slight delay, reversed gunshot tails on echoes, glass whispering, and a crisp stereo flip when positions swap.

method: Solve the Hall of Vesper identity puzzle.

identity.fantasy: Calls precise stellar bombardments that carve temporary danger lines and punish stationary elites.
identity.silhouette: White-black astral armor, long mantle patterned with moving constellations, floating targeting astrolabe above one shoulder.
identity.lore_hook: Maelis catalogues stars by the wars they ended and carries coordinates to several that should never answer.

signature: Render Line paints a narrow telegraphed stellar strike lane across valid terrain.
Parallax Battery stores charge while Maelis keeps line of sight on a stationary elite.
Falling Meridian spends stored charge on a delayed vertical impact that scales stagger rather than raw damage against bosses.
Astrolabe Shift rotates the next strike lane after an ally pings a target.
counterplay: Long telegraphs allow movement; ceilings and protected interiors disable orbital patterns.

vfx: Constellation lines draw across the ground, the shoulder astrolabe rotates faster with charge, skyward light collapses into razor-thin impact columns, and afterglow leaves temporary star-map scars.
animation: Slow astronomical hand alignment before strikes, mantle lifts in zero-wind during full charge, and recoil drives Maelis backward a half step despite no conventional weapon.
audio: Deep celestial ticking, a high descending whistle, distant thunder arriving after the flash, and quiet star-chime decay in the scorched lane.

method: Complete the Astral Battery world event with all observatories intact.

identity.fantasy: Builds controlled heat by taking and dealing damage, then vents it through area denial or converts it into armor.
identity.silhouette: Enormous dark-red furnace armor, nine glowing chest vents, molten chain-axe, smoke leaking from helmet seams.
identity.lore_hook: Eight previous Ember champions burned themselves out; Torvane survived by learning that rage is an engineering problem.

signature: Ninth Furnace accumulates heat from combat up to a visible danger threshold.
Cinderplate converts stored heat into temporary armor instead of damage output.
Red Vent releases a directional heat wave that clears lesser mobs and leaves a short denial strip.
Chain Sun cleave grows wider with heat but never beyond authored encounter caps.
counterplay: Overheating forces a vulnerable cooldown; cold effects and disengagement reduce his pressure.

vfx: Nine furnace vents illuminate one by one, armor seams glow from red to white, heat haze thickens around the axe, and Red Vent rolls forward as a low wall of sparks and distortion.
animation: Heavy chain-axe windups shorten as heat rises, emergency venting opens armor panels violently, and Cinderplate locks plates inward like a closing furnace.
audio: Layered furnace roar, chain drag, escalating pressure whistles, and an enormous valve blast when heat is vented.

method: Survive all nine stages of the Ember Crucible.

identity.fantasy: Manipulates approved combat timelines by recording squad positions, delaying hostile attacks, and restoring one tactical formation after a catastrophe.
identity.silhouette: Regal fractured-clock armor, crown of floating broken hour hands, translucent train showing multiple delayed poses at once.
identity.lore_hook: Calistra ruled a kingdom that experienced its final hour for three centuries and learned to negotiate with endings.

signature: Royal Timestamp records the squad's valid positions and selected support-state flags for a short authored window.
Ruined Second delays one telegraphed hostile attack channel rather than freezing the entire world.
Court Recall restores willing allies to recorded positions if those positions remain encounter-valid.
Throne of Hours creates a brief command zone where ability cooldown recovery is modestly accelerated.
Last Audience automatically consumes the record instead of restoring if recall would violate a protected boss phase.
counterplay: The record is visible and short-lived; protected states, objectives, and boss health never rewind.

vfx: Gold clock fractures hover around allies, delayed attack telegraphs leave transparent ghost versions, court boundaries appear as rotating numeral fragments, and recall snaps figures through layered afterimages.
animation: Every command begins with a crown-hand rotation, recalls pull her cloak and allies backward through their own afterimages, and delayed attacks visibly stutter rather than freezing globally.
audio: Layered ticking at different tempos, reversed bell tails, a royal gavel pulse on record creation, and a sudden vacuum followed by one synchronized clock strike on recall.

method: Complete the Ruined Hours raid and return Calistra's missing final minute.

identity.fantasy: Consumes temporary enemy buffs and environmental corruption to evolve his melee kit through three bounded combat forms.
identity.silhouette: Towering crimson-black demonic prince, ceremonial jaw-mask chained to his chest, two asymmetrical arms wrapped in living sigils.
identity.lore_hook: Rhazek was born heir to a court that worshipped hunger and was exiled for learning restraint.

signature: Mawbound Claim consumes one eligible lesser buff or corruption source and stores its flavor.
Prince of Teeth shifts between Hunter, Bulwark, and Ravager forms based on stored flavor and encounter need.
Royal Devour converts excess corruption into a capped stagger shield instead of raw healing.
Red Abdication sacrifices all stored flavor for one massive but telegraphed boss-break strike.
Chain of Restraint prevents autonomous frenzy while hired, making his strongest power a player-managed resource.
counterplay: Eligible buffs are curated; starvation weakens his advanced forms and Abdication leaves a long recovery.

vfx: Living red sigils crawl from consumed effects onto his arms, jaw-mask opens without touching his face, form shifts grow different horn silhouettes, and Abdication produces a huge inward-collapse ring before impact.
animation: Predatory crouch in Hunter, square planted shoulders in Bulwark, four-step accelerating combo posture in Ravager, and a full-body chain yank before Abdication.
audio: Sub-bass growls filtered through metal, snapping chain percussion, swallowed spell sounds when buffs are consumed, and a cathedral-sized bite impact on Abdication.

method: Break Rhazek's infernal succession contract and defeat his three court champions.

identity.fantasy: Stores Dawn Charges through skilled squad play and spends them on powerful protective miracles, including one heavily limited combat resurrection.
identity.silhouette: Brilliant ivory-gold plate cracked by black night lines, halo made from six rotating sunrise blades, long radiant spear.
identity.lore_hook: Aureon is said to be the final sunrise preserved from a universe that no longer has a sky.

signature: First Light earns Dawn Charges from boss weak-point breaks, successful revives, and protected-objective play.
Dawnwall projects a directional radiant barrier that weakens hostile projectiles passing through it.
Morning Spear marks an elite so squad damage fills a small shared restoration pool.
Last Sunrise spends maximum Dawn Charges to restore one eligible downed or recently eliminated ally under strict encounter rules.
Nightbreaker converts leftover charges into an anti-corruption pulse instead of wasting them between phases.
counterplay: Resurrection has encounter-level lockouts, requires maximum charge, and cannot bypass scripted wipe mechanics.

vfx: Six sunrise blades orbit the halo independently, barriers refract attacks into golden rain, resurrection builds from a tiny horizon line into a vertical dawn column, and corruption burns away as black ash turning white.
animation: Formal spear guard stances, halo blades lock into geometric shields, resurrection uses a two-handed upward spear raise, and Nightbreaker ends with the spear planted into the ground.
audio: Warm brass choir, sunrise wind, restrained spear impacts, and a massive but clean major chord when Last Sunrise succeeds.

method: Complete the Last Dawn pilgrimage and save all three sanctuary beacons.

identity.fantasy: Manipulates bounded void anchors to bend movement lanes, pull hostile projectiles off course, and create safe micro-routes through lethal arenas.
identity.silhouette: Elegant midnight armor with impossible negative-space cutouts, floating black rings around wrists and ankles, eyes rendered as tiny starfields.
identity.lore_hook: Nemea claims she is one of two sisters; records disagree on whether the other sister ever existed.

signature: Sister Anchors place two short-lived void points that curve supported movement and projectiles between them.
Black Courtesy opens a narrow safe micro-route through selected environmental hazards for nearby allies.
Absent Hand pulls lesser enemies toward a void anchor without affecting protected boss positioning.
Null Orbit causes incoming supported projectiles to bend visibly around Nemea for a short defensive window.
Missing Sister creates one decoy anchor that collapses violently if enemies commit to it.
counterplay: Anchors are visible, range-limited, and destructible; heavy boss attacks ignore hard redirection.

vfx: Perfect black disks with starfield rims, curved projectile trails, negative-space footprints along safe routes, and decoy collapse forming an inside-out sphere of purple fragments.
animation: Hands trace circular anchor geometry, movement seems to skip tiny frames near active void points, and Null Orbit holds her unnaturally still while projectiles bend around her.
audio: Low gravitational hum, reversed impact tails, muffled footsteps inside safe routes, and a sudden high crack when a decoy anchor collapses.

method: Recover both Void-Sister seals, including the one that should not exist.

identity.fantasy: Uses sacred chain constructs to limit elite movement, protect objectives, and create timed team attack windows against massive enemies.
identity.silhouette: Black cathedral plate, floating aureole made from broken chain links, enormous chain-lance coiled around one arm.
identity.lore_hook: Malachar was imprisoned as a demon, worshipped as a saint, and refuses to clarify which accusation was correct.

signature: Sainted Chain draws an authored tether between Malachar and a selected elite, limiting extreme movement without rooting protected bosses.
Reliquary Circle wraps an objective in rotating chains that intercept a limited number of incoming threats.
Penitent Window tightens existing tethers after a successful weak-point break, briefly increasing team stagger effectiveness.
Martyr Link lets Malachar absorb a capped portion of damage aimed at a protected ally.
Cathedral Lock combines active chains into one massive phase-specific restraint during supported boss mechanics.
counterplay: Chains have health and range; multiple tethers reduce Malachar's own movement and expose him to area attacks.

vfx: Black-gold chains emerge from glowing floor seals, broken aureole links rotate into complete circles during major casts, boss tethers thicken with each weak-point break, and Cathedral Lock forms towering chain arches.
animation: Whole-body lance throws, backward bracing against boss movement, one-knee objective defense, and a brutal two-hand chain pull during Penitent Window.
audio: Cathedral bells struck through chains, massive tension creaks, metallic choir resonance, and a deep lock-closing boom during Cathedral Lock.

method: Complete the Chain Saint dungeon without allowing a protected reliquary to break.

identity.fantasy: Treats vehicles as extensions of her combat kit, hot-swapping mounted effects, performing rescue pickups, and turning wrecks into temporary hazards.
identity.silhouette: Neon-orange flight suit under asymmetric ceramic armor, mirrored aviator mask, mechanical kestrel drone perched on one shoulder.
identity.lore_hook: Juno has been banned from six racing leagues, three militaries, and one moon for reasons she calls 'creative routing.'

signature: Wildfire Retrofit temporarily changes one supported vehicle subsystem between speed, armor, or combat-support tuning.
Kestrel Eye drone marks dangerous road threats and reveals nearby vehicle salvage.
Hot Pickup shortens safe ally boarding time during combat and grants a brief departure boost.
Burnout Grave turns Juno's own destroyed supported vehicle into a short-lived denial field instead of an inert wreck.
Impossible Turn enables one heavily telegraphed emergency vector correction with a long cooldown rather than unrestricted vehicle physics.
counterplay: Her strongest value disappears without vehicles; retrofits are temporary and mutually exclusive.

vfx: Neon engine tracers change color by retrofit mode, kestrel drone paints thin orange scan cones, wreck hazards burn in geometric tire patterns, and Impossible Turn leaves a corkscrew ribbon of fragmented light.
animation: Rapid cockpit handwork, shoulder drone launch with a wrist flick, aggressive body lean through turns, and a full harness snap during emergency vector correction.
audio: Turbo chirps, drone falcon-like synth cries, distorted tire harmonics, and a rising warning siren before Impossible Turn engages.

method: Win Juno's illegal cross-biome rally.

identity.fantasy: Reads the dominant damage environment and rotates through prism stances that alter her attacks, resistances, and mobility style.
identity.silhouette: Faceted iridescent armor, translucent fang-blades, long white hair refracting into spectral color bands.
identity.lore_hook: Zyrella is a living optical weapon grown inside a crystal that remembers every color it has ever seen.

signature: Prism Read samples recent supported damage channels and recommends one of several authored counter-stances.
Fang Spectrum changes blade behavior and VFX with the active stance instead of merely recoloring damage.
Chromatic Slip becomes a distinct movement action in each stance: dash, hop, slide, or brief guard-shift.
Whiteout spends all stance charge to clear selected debuffs and return to neutral.
Refraction Punish grants a short counterattack window after correctly matching an incoming supported damage family.
counterplay: Repeatedly changing enemy damage channels prevents perfect adaptation; Whiteout resets her strongest bonuses.

vfx: Armor facets reorganize with each stance, blade trails split into spectral sub-trails, matched counters flash white before resolving into the chosen color family, and Whiteout momentarily removes all color from the local character VFX.
animation: Each stance has different footwork and blade posture, transitions snap through a crystalline full-body ripple, and Whiteout freezes her silhouette for one frame before explosive reset.
audio: Glass harmonics map to stance colors, matched counters resolve into bright tonal chords, and incorrect adaptation produces intentionally rough dissonance.

method: Complete the seven-spectrum hunt and attune the Prism Fang.

entities.name: Bront Hexdrive

identity.fantasy: Deploys a compact walker platform, configurable turret logic, and moving repair geometry for high-pressure events.
identity.silhouette: Bulky cobalt engineer armor, six-tool mechanical backpack, hexagonal visor, compact two-legged siege walker folded behind him.
identity.lore_hook: Bront designed siege engines for every major faction and was fired by all of them for refusing to include an off switch.

signature: Hexwalker unfolds into a limited-duration two-legged support platform with authored weapon and utility modules.
Drive Matrix selects suppress, anti-elite, or repair behavior before deployment.
Marching Workshop projects a small moving repair radius for supported vehicles and deployables.
Siege Override spends all walker charge on one boss-armor cracking barrage with a major telegraph.
Emergency Fold recalls the walker early to recover part of its cooldown instead of losing the full cycle.
counterplay: Walker has visible health, cannot enter protected spaces, and module selection is locked until redeployment.

vfx: Hex plates unfold in precise mechanical waves, walker feet stamp luminous engineering grids, repair beams braid into rotating polygons, and Siege Override fills the platform with dangerous overbright cobalt vents.
animation: Bront assembles components with fast tool-switch choreography, physically climbs and kicks the walker into motion, then braces with both hands on a control yoke during Override.
audio: Servo chatter, huge magnetic clunks, rapid tool ratchets, and a rising industrial turbine scream before the siege barrage.

method: Premium-designated hire entitlement plus completion of the Hexdrive proving contract.

notes: Premium-designated concept; implementation must use Epic-supported in-island entitlement systems and publication rules.

entities.name: Azura Sol, Goddess of the Burning Tide
entities.role: paid-designated god-tier battle siren / oceanic solar controller

identity.fantasy: An adult war-deity who combines solar heat, tidal force, squad empowerment, and spectacular battlefield movement without relying on permanent flight.
identity.silhouette: Adult goddess in stylized iridescent armored bikini-inspired battle regalia with a flowing sun-sail mantle, gold thigh armor, high boots, radiant jewelry, and a massive crescent trident; glamorous but battle-ready rather than explicit.
identity.lore_hook: Azura is worshipped where volcanic islands meet impossible blue suns; she hires champions who can survive both her tide trial and her judgment.

signature: Burning Tide alternates a bounded arena sector between advancing solar surf and retreating cooling water, changing safe positioning without globally editing the world.
Sunwake Trident throws a returning crescent projectile whose return path can heal allies it passes near and stagger enemies it crosses.
Siren of Noon grants nearby allies a short empowered state after they execute mechanics inside her tide rather than granting a passive aura.
Tidal Crown creates a rotating ring of water that deflects selected lesser projectiles and accelerates allied movement through it.
Godwake Surge briefly transforms Azura's mantle and trident into a radiant leviathan silhouette for one cinematic multi-hit assault with explicit boss damage caps.
counterplay: Burning Tide is heavily telegraphed, Godwake has a long cooldown, and dry/protected interiors disable the largest tidal presentation.

vfx: Ocean sheets rise into gold-lit walls, solar fire runs across water without consuming it, trident trails form giant crescent suns, jewelry becomes orbiting points of light during Siren of Noon, and Godwake projects a colossal translucent solar leviathan above her path.
animation: Confident trident spins, wave-assisted leaps, one-arm sun-sail mantle flourishes, a full-body spear dive during Godwake, and a throne-like hover pose only during the brief transformation sequence.
audio: Layered surf and solar roar, powerful melodic vocal motifs without lyrics, deep trident impacts, shell-horn warning calls before tide shifts, and a huge sunrise chord during Godwake.

method: Premium-designated God hire entitlement plus completion of Azura's Burning Tide judgment.

notes: Premium-designated concept; implementation must use Epic-supported in-island entitlement systems and publication rules.

entities.name: Kharon Imperator, Lord of the Last Gate
entities.role: paid-designated god-tier frontline commander / death-denial tank

identity.fantasy: Controls a bounded last-stand domain where allies gain powerful survival tools while Kharon absorbs escalating responsibility for keeping the formation alive.
identity.silhouette: Colossal gunmetal and ivory armor, crown-like helm shaped as a fortress gate, enormous rectangular blade-shield covered in names of fallen cities.
identity.lore_hook: Kharon guards the metaphysical Last Gate and treats every hired squad as a temporary kingdom he is personally forbidden to abandon.

signature: Last Gate Domain establishes a visible fortress-shaped combat zone that strengthens defensive actions but never grants invulnerability.
Imperator's Burden redirects a capped portion of eligible ally damage into Kharon's own guard meter until the meter breaks.
Names of the Fallen stores successful rescues and revives as charges that empower later defensive counters.
No One Passes converts a lethal hit against one eligible nearby ally into a critical survival state once per major encounter under explicit lockouts.
Final Gate Counter empties Kharon's entire guard meter into a massive shield-blade counterwave whose strength depends on damage responsibly absorbed rather than raw stats.
counterplay: The domain forces positioning, Burden can break Kharon's guard, and No One Passes cannot override scripted wipes or protected elimination rules.

vfx: Fortress walls appear only as towering translucent outlines, absorbed damage writes glowing temporary names across his shield, the gate-helm opens with white internal light during rescue charges, and Final Gate Counter projects a city-sized gate silhouette that slams shut behind the shockwave.
animation: Extremely heavy shield planting, one-handed ally lifts during rescue, two-step countercharge braced behind the blade-shield, and a monumental kneeling collapse if his guard meter breaks.
audio: Stone gate groans, deep command horns, layered shield impacts stored as rhythmic pulses, whispered city names in the ambience, and an enormous closing-gate impact during Final Gate Counter.

method: Premium-designated God hire entitlement plus completion of the Last Gate ordeal.

notes: Premium-designated concept; implementation must use Epic-supported in-island entitlement systems and publication rules.
